instruction: You are given a cylinder crossflow template `/home/user/Desktop/cylinder_base/`. Implement online force-coefficient monitoring during the solve from the command line: 1. Modify and create `/home/user/Desktop/cylinder_fo/`: - Build cylinder crossflow geometry and boundary conditions - Embed a `functionObject` in `controlDict` to output cylinder force coefficients in real time - Run to convergence or fully developed state 2. Extract time-averaged lift and drag coefficients. 3. Write a post-processing script to output `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt`: - Time-averaged lift coefficient `avg_cl` - Time-averaged drag coefficient `avg_cd` - Format: `avg_cl, avg_cd` 4. Do not use GUI tools.
